tooltips.name: template
tooltips.text_desc: Description.

tooltips.name: Waypoints
tooltips.text_desc: Left click to toggle a waypoint for current viewport. Right click to show all created waypoints

tooltips.name: Workspaces Controls
tooltips.text_desc: Changes the panel layout of the applicaiton.  Review mode reduces the application to a minimal ui for reviewing scenes.  Edit mode shows more ui that allows users to modify the scene.  Edit mode also restors previously open panels.

tooltips.name: Workspace Review
tooltips.text_desc: Changes the panel layout of the applicaiton to Review mode.  Review mode reduces the application to a minimal ui for reviewing scenes.

tooltips.name: Workspace Edit
tooltips.text_desc: Changes the panel layout of the applicaiton Edit mode. Edit mode shows more ui that allows users to modify the scene.  Edit mode also restors previously open panels.

tooltips.name: Render Quality Controls
tooltips.text_desc: Toggles the entire scene's render quality or style.  Draft mode uses the RTX renderer with stream-lined settings. Lights are turned off automatically for fast rendering and interactivity. Preview mode uses the RTX renderer and utilizes more advanced settings and also uses active lights. This will take slightly longer to render as a result.  Photo mode uses the Path Trace renderer with advanced options for photo realistic results. Photo mode looks the best with the trade off that it takes the longest to render.

tooltips.name: Render Quality Draft
tooltips.text_desc: Toggles the entire scene's render quality or style.  Draft mode uses the RTX renderer with stream-lined settings. Lights are turned off automatically for fast rendering and interactivity.

tooltips.name: Render Quality Preview
tooltips.text_desc: Toggles the entire scene's render quality or style.  Preview mode uses the RTX renderer and utilizes more advanced settings and also uses active lights. This will take slightly longer to render as a result.

tooltips.name: Render Quality Photo
tooltips.text_desc: Toggles the entire scene's render quality or style.  Photo mode uses the Path Trace renderer with advanced options for photo realistic results. Photo mode looks the best with the trade off that it takes the longest to render.

tooltips.name: Render Style Controls
tooltips.text_desc: Render style allows the user to change the style of the renderer based on the current render quality.  Current styles are Shaded mode (default) and White Mode. White Mode replaces all materials with a uniform white material with the exception of certain materials.  The exception list is defaulted to Sky and Glass materials however this list can be edited in the main preferences.

tooltips.name: Render Style Shaded
tooltips.text_desc: Render style allows the user to change the style of the renderer based on the current render quality. Shaded Mode is the default mode.

tooltips.name: Render Style White
tooltips.text_desc: Render style allows the user to change the style of the renderer based on the current render quality. White Mode replaces all materials with a uniform white material with the exception of certain materials. The exception list is defaulted to Sky and Glass materials however this list can be edited in the main preferences.

tooltips.name: Live Mode
tooltips.text_desc: Live mode allows the user to sync changes between different applications and users via Omnvierse. User(s) must be signed into an Omnvierse Server to use Live mode.

tooltips.name: User Sign in
tooltips.text_desc: Display the state of the user's sign-in status. When red, no user is signed in.  When green and sign in name is displayed, user is successfully signed-in.

tooltips.name: Display Options
tooltips.text_desc: Display options allow the user to toggle which Viewport Visualizers are currently active.

tooltips.name: Camera
tooltips.text_desc: The most common camera controls are always available in the Viewport Dahboard. Users can select between Cameras and Views.  Users can also adjust the camera navigation speed from the camera menu.  Settings can be locked so that they cannot be changed with out, first unlocking the camera.  Additional camera controls are revealed through an expandable UI including lens, focal distance, and view ratio.

tooltips.name: Screenshots
tooltips.text_desc: Screen-shot controls are ancored to the right of the Viewport Dashboard. Click on this button to takes a screen shot in the current mode.  Click on the right bottom arrow to popup the screenshot settings.

tooltips.name: Select Model
tooltips.text_desc: Select Model mode selects a defined object group, referred to as a model.  Pressing Q toggles the selection mode.

tooltips.name: Select Part
tooltips.text_desc: Select Part mode selects individual parts of a defined model, referred to as a part.  Select Part mode is visualized in the viewport by a bounding box that is placed around the encompassing model. Pressing Q toggles the selection mode.

tooltips.name: Move
tooltips.text_desc: Provides users a gizmo in the viewport to move the selected object in global or local space.  Pressing W toggles the active space between global and local. Transform space is indicated on the icon by a blue tint for global and a yellow tint for local.

tooltips.name: Rotate
tooltips.text_desc: Provides users a gizmo in the viewport to rotate the selected object in global or local space.   Pressing E toggles the active space between global and local. Transform space is indicated on the icon by a blue tint for global and a yellow tint for local.

tooltips.name: Scale
tooltips.text_desc: Provides users a gizmo in the viewport to rotate the selected object in global space.  Scale is always in global space

tooltips.name: Snap
tooltips.text_desc: Click to enable/disable snapping, Right-click to show snap-settings

tooltips.name: Transform Space Toggle
tooltips.text_desc: Manually toggles the transform space of the move and rotate tools

tooltips.name: Transform Space Toggle
tooltips.text_desc: manually toiggles the transform space of the move and rotate tools

tooltips.name: Light Toggle
tooltips.text_desc: Toggles all lights in the scene on and off with the exception of lights associated with the sky.

tooltips.name: Material Browser
tooltips.text_desc: The Material Browser displays materials grouped in categories, Right Click a material to apply them to selected objects.

tooltips.name: Movie Capture
tooltips.text_desc: Renders a movie clip of the sun study.

tooltips.name: Set Date and Time
tooltips.text_desc: Set's the scene date and time. Required to set the sun position correctly.

tooltips.name: Set Location
tooltips.text_desc: Set's the scenes location.  Required to set the sun position/arc correctly.

tooltips.name: Sun Study
tooltips.text_desc: Allows user to scrub the time of day and preview the sun's course throughout a day. Note: A Sun Study can only be used with Dynamic Skies.

tooltips.name: Stage Hierarchy
tooltips.text_desc: Displays the hiearchical object relationship for the entire scene. Selection is mirrored between this panel and the Viewport

tooltips.name: Render Settings
tooltips.text_desc: Advanced render settings that allow a user to fine-tune the look of a scene through render settings for all renderers.

tooltips.name: Preferences
tooltips.text_desc: All preferences and applications are set here.

tooltips.name: Asset Browser
tooltips.text_desc: Browses files and allows users to add assets to the world.
